A Portland jury unanimously rejected a $10 million civil suit brought by an intruder against a 70-year-old business owner who defended his living quarters with a firearm.

The Bright Side:
Even in a notoriously lenient legal environment, common-sense citizens stepped up to stop predatory lawsuits against victims defending their homes.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing victim and perpetrator (WHO), testing whether a criminal can profit from his own unlawful trespass.

Social Physics Analysis:
By holding accountable actors who manufacture grievances through unlawful intrusion, the judicial process restored alignment between personal responsibility and legal consequences.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map the alignment between justice and ground-level outcomes, it plots a direct trajectory toward societal restoration and legal clarity.

The Unavoidable Truth: Criminals cannot use the civil court system to monetize their own violent trespasses.
The Unavoidable Lie: Breaking into a home creates a valid claim for multi-million dollar damages.

Justice holds when courts refuse to let bad actors weaponize the legal system against citizens protecting their lives and property.

No one should have to live in fear of both a criminal breaking into their home and a subsequent lawsuit seeking to destroy what little they have left.
